name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis, including an in-driver taste-funnel explore state and design-ratification state) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → optional /spec:design (mock-bound, deterministic fidelity gates) → /spec:build (spec-build-driver.js stepped, driver-stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, and the ledger row driven; test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, and repair held by the session) → /spec:review (spec-review-driver.js stepped, driver-stepped: deterministic legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros; verdict derived by verdict.js) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.52.0 — loop checkpoint fails closed (specs/20260901/05-checkpoint-fail-closed.md): a `--via loop` review that reaches `reviewer-returned` with no `.claude/spec-session.json` now parks at CHECKPOINT with a restart remedy (a stale plugin hook set is the usual cause — hooks load at session start, so `/clear` does not reload them) instead of degrading to a printed warning that admitted DISPOSITIONS with no ledger trace; the park lifts once any stamp appears. `spec-review-driver.js` records `checkpoint: {sessionId}` at `reviewer-returned` and refuses `--mark dispositions` until that condition clears; the sole other exit is `--mark dispositions … --skip-independence-check-because "<reason>"`, admitted only on a no-stamp park and refused everywhere else (a same-session park still names `/clear`; a run that isn't parked, or is `--via direct`, refuses the flag outright). `verdict.js` gains `--checkpoint <cleared|stamp-appeared|overridden|not-reached>` and `--checkpoint-reason <text>` (review profile only), writing `checkpoint: {outcome}` — with `reason` when `overridden` — onto every loop review row right after `verdict`, so how often the gate is skipped, and why, is a ledger query. 7.51.0 — shell-composed mocks (specs/20260901/04-shell-composed-mocks.md): mocks now share one canonical app shell instead of each author copying chrome by hand — `design/shell/<name>.html` (plus a linked `.css`) is the canon, a page mock declares `data-shell="<name>"`/`"none"` and owns only its content slot, and `design-atlas.js shell sync` rewrites every declaring mock's region from canon byte-for-byte (active-nav derived, `built` mocks skipped by default); `shell adopt` migrates pre-shell mocks via a confirmed plan. `check` gains a tiered shell family (warn at `sketch`, violation at `ratified`/`approved`/`--matrix`); genesis `--mark tokens-landed` now also requires the shell canon to pass `check`, and `--mark rules-locked` authors `AppShell` from it. Sketch-tier authorship (the atlas gap sweep, sketch's scoped sweep) moves to the planning seat (ADR-0003, reversing specs/20260810/01 D8): the journey-central set in-session, the rest by one sequential `Agent {model: "fable"}` dispatch (Opus fallback), Sonnet mechanical-only, grounded in the picked position brief — restored to one shared paragraph in design.md § Design Atlas that atlas.md/sketch.md both cite, named in both commands' reports via a new `🎨 position: …` bullet. 7.50.0 — unified build loop (specs/20260901/03-unified-build-loop.md): /spec:build becomes the per-feature loop carrying a spec from hardened to done, deriving the next stage from disk and running design (when due), then the build driver, then the review driver in sequence, each `--via loop`. One checkpoint is enforced: a loop-driven review parks at a new CHECKPOINT state after the reviewer returns and refuses DISPOSITIONS until the session id in `.claude/spec-session.json` changes (a `/clear` and re-run), once per run, degrading to a printed warning when no stamp exists; the pre-merge stop stays the existing worktree step-out, never a forced clear. `spec-state-gate.sh` admits `/spec:build` on `hardened|implementing|done`. `core.md`'s § State Machine now attributes each transition to a driver state rather than a command: plan's lock → `hardened`, the build driver's preflight → `implementing`, the review driver's close → `done`; `/spec:build` runs both drivers in sequence and `/spec:review` remains the review driver's direct entry. `fleet-reader.js` gains the seventh fixed question `cleanByVia`, scoring escapes-per-CLEAN separately for `loop` / `direct` / `unknown` review rows — the number the brief's kill condition reads.
